template.name: HSI First 30m Candle
template.notes: The first-30-minute session range collapses to the prior bar on the daily engine, so the long entry is a close above the prior bar high with the prior bar low as the mirror exit. The opposite-side stop and the RiskReward 1 range-multiple target are price levels, not percentages, and the once-per-day cap and 5-minute session are not expressible.
